# CerbIA

## CerbIA

- [Home](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/): Security gates for AI agents' inputs and outputs. Check prompts, files, instructions, configurations, and agent interactions before application, CI/CD, or local use.

## Documentation

- [About CerbIA](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/about/): Security gates for AI agents' inputs and outputs.
- [Additional information](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/additional-information/): CerbIA change history, support, and security reporting information.
- [Architecture](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/architecture/): See how entries move from input through preprocessing and gate evaluation to scan results.
- [CLI reference](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/cli/): Use the CerbIA CLI to validate YAML pipelines and scan text or files from the command line.
- [Configuration](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/configuration/): Configure a CerbIA security gate in YAML, including component classes, initialization arguments, and validation rules.
- [Contributing](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/contributing/): Ways to contribute to CerbIA and links to its contribution rules.
- [Gates](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/gate/): Understand how simple and cascade gates turn scanner findings into an allow or block verdict.
- [Guides](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/guides-overview/): Guided paths for trying and extending CerbIA security gates.
- [Internationalization](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/i18n/): Register and select language-specific pattern packs for CerbIA's built-in scanners.
- [Logging](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/logging/): Configure host application logging for CerbIA's standard-library logger namespace and levels.
- [Packages](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/packages/): Choose a CerbIA distribution and open its package module for installation and API details.
- [Prerequisites](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/prerequisites/): Requirements and installation steps before using CerbIA.
- [Getting started](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/quickstart/): Build and run a first CerbIA pipeline from loaders, scanners, and a YAML configuration.
- [Reference](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/reference-overview/): CerbIA configuration, command, component, and package reference.
- [Custom components](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/components/custom-components/): Define and load custom pipeline components from fully qualified Python classes in configuration.
- [Loaders](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/components/loaders/): Load inline text or local files into entries for the CerbIA processing pipeline.
- [Preprocessors](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/components/preprocessors/): Transform loaded entries before scanning with decoding and whitespace-normalization preprocessors.
- [Scanners](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/components/scanners/): Browse scanners for hidden text, prompt injection, PII, secrets, URLs, keywords, and other findings.
- [Score aggregators](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/components/score-aggregators/): Choose how severity-weighted blocking findings become the score compared with the gate threshold.
- [FileLoader](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/components/loaders/file-loader/): Load UTF-8 text from files or recursively discovered directory trees, with optional suffix filters.
- [TextLoader](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/components/loaders/text-loader/): Load one string or an ordered list of inline strings as CerbIA entries.
- [Speculative decoding](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/components/preprocessors/speculative-decoding/): Recover plausible encoded or obfuscated text before scanners inspect an entry.
- [Whitespace normalization](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/components/preprocessors/whitespace-normalization/): Normalize spaced, tabbed, and repeated whitespace patterns while preserving entry lineage.
- [Canary leak scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/components/scanners/canary-leak/): Find configured canary tokens and partial leaks, including encoded or zero-width representations.
- [Decisions scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/components/scanners/decisions/): Ask fixed questions about text and evaluate typed answers with an application function.
- [Invisible text scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/components/scanners/invisible-text/): Detect zero-width, bidirectional, format-control, and other hard-to-see Unicode characters.
- [Keyword scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/components/scanners/keyword/): Match multilingual and code-oriented suspicious patterns after Unicode and leetspeak normalization.
- [Presidio PII scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/components/scanners/pii-presidio/): Detect English PII entities with the optional Presidio analyzer and spaCy model integration.
- [PII scanners](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/components/scanners/pii/): Detect common personally identifiable information with built-in or custom regular expressions.
- [ProtectAI prompt injection scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/components/scanners/prompt-injection-protectai/): Classify text for prompt injection with the optional ProtectAI DeBERTa-v3 integration.
- [Prompt injection scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/components/scanners/prompt-injection/): Detect multilingual prompt-injection patterns such as instruction override, exfiltration, and role hijacking.
- [Secret scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/components/scanners/secrets/): Detect configured credential patterns and optionally flag unmatched high-entropy values.
- [URL allowlist scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/components/scanners/url-allow-list/): Allow only URLs that match configured full-URL wildcard patterns.
- [URL denylist scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/components/scanners/url-deny-list/): Flag extracted URLs that match configured deny rules.
- [Malicious URL scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/components/scanners/url-malicious/): Apply local heuristics to extracted URLs, including risky domains, shorteners, and lookalike patterns.
- [XSS scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/components/scanners/xss/): Detect encoded HTML and script injection vectors with optional markup-context awareness.
- [Maximum score with bonus](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/components/score-aggregators/max-with-bonus/): Combine the highest blocking score with a configurable bonus for each additional blocking finding.
- [Maximum score aggregator](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/components/score-aggregators/max/): Use the highest severity-weighted blocking score as the aggregate gate score.
- [Mean score aggregator](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/prerelease/main/components/score-aggregators/mean/): Average all severity-weighted blocking scores to produce the aggregate gate score.

- [Presidio PII scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.5.0/main/components/scanners/pii-presidio/): Detect English PII entities with the optional Presidio analyzer and spaCy model integration.
- [PII scanners](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.5.0/main/components/scanners/pii/): Detect common personally identifiable information with built-in or custom regular expressions.
- [ProtectAI prompt injection scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.5.0/main/components/scanners/prompt-injection-protectai/): Classify text for prompt injection with the optional ProtectAI DeBERTa-v3 integration.
- [Prompt injection scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.5.0/main/components/scanners/prompt-injection/): Detect multilingual prompt-injection patterns such as instruction override, exfiltration, and role hijacking.
- [URL allowlist scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.5.0/main/components/scanners/url-allow-list/): Allow only URLs that match configured full-URL wildcard patterns.
- [URL denylist scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.5.0/main/components/scanners/url-deny-list/): Flag extracted URLs that match configured deny rules.
- [XSS scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.5.0/main/components/scanners/xss/): Detect encoded HTML and script injection vectors with optional markup-context awareness.
- [Decisions scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.5.0/main/components/scanners/decisions/): Ask fixed questions about text and evaluate typed answers with an application function.
- [Secret scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.5.0/main/components/scanners/secrets/): Detect configured credential patterns and optionally flag unmatched high-entropy values.
- [Malicious URL scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.5.0/main/components/scanners/url-malicious/): Apply local heuristics to extracted URLs, including risky domains, shorteners, and lookalike patterns.
- [FileLoader](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.5.0/main/components/loaders/file-loader/): Load UTF-8 text from files or recursively discovered directory trees, with optional suffix filters.
- [Architecture](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.5.0/main/architecture/): Trace an entry through loading, preprocessing, scanning, aggregation, and result construction.
- [Speculative decoding](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.5.0/main/components/preprocessors/speculative-decoding/): Recover plausible encoded or obfuscated text before scanners inspect an entry.
- [Internationalization](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.5.0/main/i18n/): Register and select language-specific pattern packs for CerbIA's built-in scanners.
- [About CerbIA](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.4.0/main/about/): Security gates for AI agents' inputs and outputs.
- [Additional information](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.4.0/main/additional-information/): CerbIA change history, support, and security reporting information.
- [CLI reference](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.4.0/main/cli/): Use the CerbIA CLI to validate YAML pipelines and scan text or files from the command line.
- [Configuration](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.4.0/main/configuration/): Configure a CerbIA security gate in YAML, including component classes, initialization arguments, and validation rules.
- [Contributing](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.4.0/main/contributing/): Ways to contribute to CerbIA and links to its contribution rules.
- [Gate behavior](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.4.0/main/gate/): Understand how SecurityGate combines scanner findings, actions, scores, and thresholds into a verdict.
- [Guides](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.4.0/main/guides-overview/): Guided paths for trying and extending CerbIA security gates.
- [Logging](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.4.0/main/logging/): Configure host application logging for CerbIA's standard-library logger namespace and levels.
- [Packages](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.4.0/main/packages/): Choose a CerbIA distribution and open its package module for installation and API details.

- [Loaders](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.4.0/main/components/loaders/): Load inline text or local files into entries for the CerbIA processing pipeline.
- [Preprocessors](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.4.0/main/components/preprocessors/): Transform loaded entries before scanning with decoding and whitespace-normalization preprocessors.
- [Scanners](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.4.0/main/components/scanners/): Browse scanners for hidden text, prompt injection, PII, secrets, URLs, keywords, and other findings.
- [Score aggregators](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.4.0/main/components/score-aggregators/): Choose how severity-weighted blocking findings become the score compared with the gate threshold.
- [TextLoader](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.4.0/main/components/loaders/text-loader/): Load one string or an ordered list of inline strings as CerbIA entries.
- [Whitespace normalization](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.4.0/main/components/preprocessors/whitespace-normalization/): Normalize spaced, tabbed, and repeated whitespace patterns while preserving entry lineage.
- [Canary leak scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.4.0/main/components/scanners/canary-leak/): Find configured canary tokens and partial leaks, including encoded or zero-width representations.
- [Invisible text scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.4.0/main/components/scanners/invisible-text/): Detect zero-width, bidirectional, format-control, and other hard-to-see Unicode characters.
- [Keyword scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.4.0/main/components/scanners/keyword/): Match multilingual and code-oriented suspicious patterns after Unicode and leetspeak normalization.

- [Prompt injection scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.4.0/main/components/scanners/prompt-injection/): Detect multilingual prompt-injection patterns such as instruction override, exfiltration, and role hijacking.

- [XSS scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.4.0/main/components/scanners/xss/): Detect encoded HTML and script injection vectors with optional markup-context awareness.
- [Maximum score with bonus](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.4.0/main/components/score-aggregators/max-with-bonus/): Combine the highest blocking score with a configurable bonus for each additional blocking finding.
- [Maximum score aggregator](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.4.0/main/components/score-aggregators/max/): Use the highest severity-weighted blocking score as the aggregate gate score.
- [Mean score aggregator](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.4.0/main/components/score-aggregators/mean/): Average all severity-weighted blocking scores to produce the aggregate gate score.

- [Maximum score aggregator](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.3.0/main/components/score-aggregators/max/): Use the highest severity-weighted blocking score as the aggregate gate score.
- [Mean score aggregator](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.3.0/main/components/score-aggregators/mean/): Average all severity-weighted blocking scores to produce the aggregate gate score.
- [Canary leak scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.3.0/main/components/scanners/canary-leak/): Find configured canary tokens and partial leaks, including encoded or zero-width representations.
- [Invisible text scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.3.0/main/components/scanners/invisible-text/): Detect zero-width, bidirectional, format-control, and other hard-to-see Unicode characters.
- [Keyword scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.3.0/main/components/scanners/keyword/): Match multilingual and code-oriented suspicious patterns after Unicode and leetspeak normalization.
- [Presidio PII scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.3.0/main/components/scanners/pii-presidio/): Detect English PII entities with the optional Presidio analyzer and spaCy model integration.
- [PII scanners](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.3.0/main/components/scanners/pii/): Detect common personally identifiable information with built-in or custom regular expressions.
- [ProtectAI prompt injection scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.3.0/main/components/scanners/prompt-injection-protectai/): Classify text for prompt injection with the optional ProtectAI DeBERTa-v3 integration.
- [Prompt injection scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.3.0/main/components/scanners/prompt-injection/): Detect multilingual prompt-injection patterns such as instruction override, exfiltration, and role hijacking.
- [Secret scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.3.0/main/components/scanners/secrets/): Detect configured credential patterns and optionally flag unmatched high-entropy values.
- [URL allowlist scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.3.0/main/components/scanners/url-allowlist/): Allow only URLs that match configured full-URL wildcard patterns.
- [Malicious URL scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.3.0/main/components/scanners/url-malicious/): Apply local heuristics to extracted URLs, including risky domains, shorteners, and lookalike patterns.
- [XSS scanner](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.3.0/main/components/scanners/xss/): Detect encoded HTML and script injection vectors with optional markup-context awareness.
- [Architecture](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.3.0/main/architecture/): Trace an entry through loading, preprocessing, scanning, aggregation, and result construction.
- [FileLoader](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.3.0/main/components/loaders/file-loader/): Load UTF-8 text from files or recursively discovered directory trees, with optional suffix filters.
- [Speculative decoding](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.3.0/main/components/preprocessors/speculative-decoding/): Recover plausible encoded or obfuscated text before scanners inspect an entry.
- [Internationalization](https://inditextech.github.io/cerbia/0.3.0/main/i18n/): Register and select language-specific pattern packs for CerbIA's built-in scanners.
